items.summary: Recommendation: accept both CRO leads only as bounded disposable research, not production work. Evidence: MarkItDown passed 8/8 checks with MIT licensing; shadcn/ui passed 3/3 with MIT licensing. The fleet has 156 approved proposals without execution, 24 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and 24 failed requests, so no new production queue work is justified. Owner decision: authorize both prototypes, or defer them until backlog and measurement gates drain.

CRO handoff accepted for CTO review: prototype MarkItDown and isolated CTA primitives without dependency installation, production access, deployment, spend, or credential changes. Acceptance requires measurable editor correction time or accessibility/weight results and explicit go/iterate/drop decisions.
